catalog_source.integration: independent risk-validation implementation; repository code is not executed or copied

target.return_source: causal reconstruction from the portfolio's frozen source snapshot and rules

methods.source_gaussian_gbm: repository drift equals mean log return minus half log-return variance; independent Gaussian innovations
methods.iid_empirical: weekly simple returns sampled independently with replacement
methods.moving_block_13w: circular 13-week historical blocks sampled with replacement
methods.moving_block_13w_mean_haircut: 13-week blocks with 50 percent of a positive historical weekly arithmetic mean subtracted from every sampled week
methods.forced_worst_13w_then_blocks: five-year paths begin with the historically worst compounded 13-week block, followed by circular 13-week block sampling

interpretation.purpose: risk estimation and model falsification, not price prediction or alpha generation
interpretation.source_best_fit_path: diagnostic only and never used for allocation
interpretation.promotion_effect: cannot approve live trading or complete the untouched forward clock
